title: Remove Duplicates From Sorted List
description: Remove duplicate values from a sorted linked list so each value appears once.

data.text: Given the head of a sorted linked list, delete all duplicates so that each value appears only once.

data.title: New List O(n) O(n)
Relink O(n) O(1)
What improved
data.text: Creating a brand new list works but allocates fresh nodes even though the original ones are still usable. Since the list is already sorted, duplicates sit right next to each other. You can simply skip over duplicate nodes by relinking the current node directly to the node after the duplicate block.

cards.title: Build New List
cards.description: Copy unique values into a freshly allocated list

cards.title: In-Place Relink
cards.description: Skip duplicates by rewiring Next pointers
